title: Call / Response Gap Practice
purpose: Practice internal time and phrasing against two bars of accompaniment followed by two bars of full-band space.
feel: straight restrained rock pocket with deliberate full-band gaps

tracks.name: Drums
tracks.instrument_intent: steady reference groove during call bars; completely silent during response-space bars

tracks.name: Bass
tracks.instrument_intent: simple roots and fifths that stop with the drums during response-space bars

provenance.notes: Original practice vamp using a public deterministic groove preset and arrangement-wide gap cycle.
